title: Invalidate stale automatic handoff after brief edits
description: When a valid operator-owned project brief is persisted, durably replace the generated automatic orchestrator handoff with the empty four-field record in the same RunStore transaction. This makes the operator brief immediately supersede session-derived context instead of leaving two conflicting memories. A subsequent successfully parsed orchestrator turn may populate the handoff again through the existing path. Preserve the orchestrator transcript, provider session ids, project brief normalization, typed command authority, and the existing GET /api/brief response shape; after the brief write, that GET returns the saved brief beside an empty handoff until a later orchestrator turn. An invalid or refused brief write must change neither record. Add focused store and HTTP regression coverage and adjust directly affected documentation. Do not add a table, endpoint, timestamp/freshness heuristic, model call, gate, or lifecycle behavior.

spec.scope: Add one typed conversational command, update_project_brief, carrying the complete normalized four-field project brief. The read-only orchestrator may select it only when the current operator message explicitly requests or confirms that brief write; for suggestions or ambiguous intent it must use none and ask or present wording without mutation. The deterministic service executor, never the agent process, persists the command through the same RunRuntime/RunStore operation used by the trusted same-origin brief editor. The already durable operator message, orchestrator response, and system command result remain the authorization trail. A successful manual or conversational brief write must atomically persist the brief and replace the generated automatic handoff with the empty four-field record, so human-authorized intent immediately supersedes session-derived context; a later successfully parsed orchestrator turn may populate the handoff again. Preserve transcript, provider session ids, normalization limits, GET /api/brief shape, typed lifecycle authority, and direct editor behavior. Invalid/refused writes change neither record. Update the structured schema/parser, prompt, executor, English and Portuguese product copy, focused store/orchestrator/HTTP/UI tests, and directly affected documentation. Keep the RunRuntime operation transport-neutral so a future MCP adapter can reuse it, but do not add an MCP server, endpoint, table, pending-draft workflow, timestamp heuristic, model call, gate, or other lifecycle behavior in this slice.
